paite: Philistia mite'n Israel adou ua; huchi in Israel mite Philistia mite ma ah ataikek ua, Gilboa tang ah thah in a-om uhi.
heading: Kumpipa Saul Sihna / (1 Sam 31.1-13)
english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

paite: Philistia mite'n Saul leh atapate adelh vengveng ua; Philistia mite'n Jonathan, Abinadab leh Malki-shua, Saul tapate athat uhi.
english: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

paite: Huchi in kidouna Saul a ding in ahaksa mahmahta a, thalkap mite'n amah aphata uh; huan thalkap mite ziak in alungkham mahmah hi.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

paite: Huchih lai in Saul in agalvan popa kiang ah, "Na namsau dokkhia inla, huai in hon dawt pailet in; huchi lou in zaw hiai zeksumlouhte hong pai in bawl louhlouh in ahon bawl kha ding uh," achi a. Himahleh agalvan popa a-ut kei; alau mahmah ngal a. Huaiziak in Saul in anamsau ala a kisiatna in aneita hi.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

paite: Agalvan popa'n Saul asita chih atheih in, huai bangmah in ama'n leng anamsau kisiatna in azang a asita hi.
english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.

paite: Huchi in Saul asita a, atapa thumte; huan a-inkote tengteng leng asikhawm vek uhi.
english: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.

paite: Guam a om Israel mite tengteng in sepaihte taikek leh Saul leh atapate asi uh chih amuh un akhopite uh anusia ua, ataikekta uhi. Philistia mite ahong ua huaite ah atengta uhi.
english: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

paite: Azingsang in hichi ahi a, thahsate puante suah ding a Philistia mite ahong pai lai un, Gilboa tang ah Saul leh atapate apuk uh chih amu uhi.
english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

paite: Huan amah vante asuah ua, alutang ala ua, agalvan leng, amilimte uh kiang leh mite kiang ah tanchin puak ding in Philistia mite gamsung ah akhak kimvel vek uhi.
english: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.

paite: Huchi in agalvan apathiante uh inn ah akoih ua, Dagon tempul ah alutang atak uhi.
english: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

paite: Jabesh-gilead tengteng in Saul tung a Philistia mite thilhih tengteng azak un,
english: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

paite: mihangsante tengteng athou ua, Saul luang leh atapate luang ava lamang ua, Jabesh ah ahon pua ua, Jabesh a tosaw sing nuai ah aguhte uh avui ua, ni sagih an angawl uhi.
english: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA tung a tatlekna hih a, TOUPA thu azuih louh a, dawi zawl aisan siam thu adot ziak in Saul asita hi.
english: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against Yahweh, because of Yahweh’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,

paite: Huai a thu kan a, TOUPA a kipan thu akan louh ziak in: huaiziak in amah athat a, lalgam Jesse tapa David kiang ah apeta hi.
english: and didn’t inquire of Yahweh. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.
